mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns is not negative (r >= 0) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) combined with strong housing starts (HOUST > 1200) indicates a robust labor market and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5% AND HOUST > 1200, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.1pp in 1 month) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1250 thousand units indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1250, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 109.5 over the past month signals robust economic output, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 109.5, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market and strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1200) combined with high residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 500000) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS > 500000, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
